reports.title: Astrana Health, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Based on the Company’s existing business, current view of existing market conditions, and assumptions, the Company is providing guidance for total revenue and Adjusted EBITDA for the quarter ending December 31, 2026 and narrowing guidance for total revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, and free cash flow for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Three Months Ending December 31, 2026 | Year Ending December 31, 2026
Guidance Range | Guidance Range
($ in millions) | Low | High | Low | High
Total revenue | 939 | 1,039 | 3,900 | 4,000
Adjusted EBITDA | 48.5 | 61.5 | 261 | 274
Free cash flow | 107.5 | 130
